rows.text: After several Amber Eras of research and development, the Zimander Federation finally succeeded in nurturing a creature capable of processing entropic energy — the "Entropy Scavenger." This organism absorbs entropic energy from its surrounding environment and concentrates it within itself, much like an air conditioner. The Zimander people placed them in laboratories to clean up the waste generated during Anti-Entropy experiments. Later, the Zimander Federation was destroyed by Anti-Entropy machines, though a small number of Entropy Scavengers survived thanks to their unique traits. One of the cultivation pods was recovered by the Annihilation Gang, whose leader considered it a treasure beyond price and resolved to build it up as a secret weapon. The gang managed to use it to demolish three space junkyards and raid one abandoned barge before ultimately falling apart in a chaotic bout of infighting.
